snippet.title: Beloved Bound Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Beloved Bound is an adventure game where Tan uncovers memories, makes friends, and discovers secrets in a dreamlike Boundscape.
Solve puzzles, play mini-games, and discover what lies beyond the sanctuary.

Demo coming soon!
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3886970/Beloved_Bound
